🐱 The Ultimate Cat Burglar – Sneak, distract, and outsmart your way past obsessive cat ladies, laser-grid security systems, and rival thieves also after the prize.
😼 Each Cat is a Challenge – From a tech mogul’s cyborg Persian to a mafia boss’s grumpy tabby, every mission requires a new strategy (and maybe some catnip bribery).

🏡 Home Invasion Hijinks – Break into luxury penthouses, suburban homes, and even a cat-themed supervillain lair, each packed with absurd security measures.
🐾 Become the Legendary "Whisker Bandit" – Upgrade your gear, unlock new feline-napping techniques, and build a reputation in the underground world of pet theft.
